meaning: Verify finite source-derived named-sum payload production and plain Enum runtime-definition/component consumption using original generated providers, independent native observations and retained execution custody.
inputs: Registered checked source graph, selected reconciled plan, complete boundary, exact definition bytes; equal graph/source/plan/boundary identities. Every source Enum retained. No fabricated record, factory, Rule, or domain relationship.

relations: source root selects provider through a typed occurrence
provider normalizes and keys owned input
plain component reads original definition members
execution binds exact artifacts and tool identities

sum_protocol.scope: Payload sums with named runtime imports. Pure structural/scalar sums are explicitly inapplicable to provider-call coverage; existing standalone semantic controls remain required. Preserve all variants, including branches with zero provider calls, in applicable families.
sum_protocol.derivation: Decode typed variants in canonical code-unit name order. Recursively retain optional/list/set/inline-sum paths and every named import occurrence, not just each unique provider. Keep all non-selected runtime edges uncovered.
sum_protocol.witnesses: All finite source-valid samples from checked value context; at every reached named occurrence replace exactly one leaf with raw, shallow-cloned or foreign-provider value. Each occurrence must reach all four ownership modes. Resource exhaustion or unavailable record witness makes whole family not_evaluable, never a prefix pass.
sum_protocol.calls: Original root create only. Build dependencies/foreign instances before capture and inspect results after. Each named normalize calls original isOwned once; unowned fails immediately with kind-specific TypeError. List/set normalize and key each element in input order; inline sum normalizes then keys its selected payload. Cached collection/structural-sum keys do not re-call children. Root sum key reads its cached structural key.
sum_protocol.arguments: Record all actual call arities, qualified provider identity, method, exact input object identity paths, returned ownership/key or error. Preserve singleton plain-Enum aliases; independently constructed record/sum values do not alias.
sum_protocol.outcomes: Source-derived normalized view, nominal key, owned/frozen output, or exact UNOWNED_ENTITY/UNOWNED_COMPONENT/UNOWNED_ENUM_CASE/UNOWNED_SUM_CASE error. Getter count zero and descriptor-graph input/construction stability. General malformed scalar/structural behavior belongs to existing semantic controls, not invented cross-edge coverage.

enum_protocol.scope: Every plain Enum independently, including multiple definitions sharing the same runtime. Definition-to-runtime and component-to-definition edges are separate protocol occurrences; EnumValue imports are type-only.
enum_protocol.derivation: Source variant names map to same-name wire values, in configured code-unit member order. Exact module paths, symbols, members and import occurrences from checked source/configuration, never generated expected text.
enum_protocol.observations: Fresh original CommonJS closure. Wrap original defineEnum while loading the original definition; record arity, input/output data members, output frozen status and input descriptor stability. Return its original owned object unchanged. While loading the component, expose a temporary transparent read-only proxy for that definition export only; record each actual member get in order with returned value. Restore the original export. No proxy enters runtime composeEnum ownership.
enum_protocol.outcomes: Exactly one defineEnum call and exactly one member read per declared case in configured order; descriptor-checked component values cover exactly source names, frozen/owned singleton cases, nominal keys and source variant values. Validate original definition ownership with composeEnum outside capture. Incorrect, duplicated, missing or redirected reads/calls reject even if final values match.

source_surface: Reuse checked data-root surface derivation for actual Enum/sum roots and recursive Entity/VO/Rule dependencies. Preserve all named import occurrences, type-only erasure, exact qualified ownership and complete exports. Source and native AST audits use this exact definition before original execution.
execution: Independently weak-register controls and source surface; reuse retained private executor. Closed data options, pinned tools, strict CommonJS compile, captured-source operation, permission-restricted observer, exact observations and complete artifact/tool fingerprints before/after children and receipt assertions. Reject cloned, foreign, stale or empty-family evidence.
tools: Node 26.8.1 and TypeScript 7.0.2; no new package installation, public default or source-capsule registration.
claim_ceiling: Finite private original-provider instrumentation plus independent module audits and retained currentness. Not universal or uninstrumented equivalence, public cross-generator completion, other metatype coverage, a default change, installation, publication, release or authority.
